description: Extend PulseFlow with outbound webhook dispatchers, telemetry data exports, key auto-rotation policies, and invitation token verification.

userStories.title: Outbound Webhooks Delivery Engine
userStories.description: As a workspace administrator, I want to configure outbound webhook HTTP endpoints so that third-party systems receive automated POST notifications when error spikes or latency thresholds are breached.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Webhook model to schema.prisma (id, workspaceId, url, secretKey, events, active, createdAt)
Implement GET and POST /api/workspaces/[id]/webhooks route handlers
Add Webhooks management tab or section to Workspace Settings with test delivery ping
userStories.notes: Ensure webhook secrets are generated with crypto.randomBytes and requests are sent with X-PulseFlow-Signature header.

userStories.title: Telemetry Raw Data Exporter (CSV/JSON)
userStories.description: As an engineering analyst, I want to export raw metric events from the analytics dashboard in CSV or JSON format for external BI analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GET /api/workspaces/[id]/metrics/export endpoint supporting format=csv and format=json
Add 'Export Raw Telemetry' button with dropdown on the Analytics page
Include timestamp, eventType, source, statusCode, latencyMs, and payload in export
userStories.notes: Stream or paginate large datasets to avoid memory exhaustion.

userStories.title: API Key Expiration & Rotation Safeguards
userStories.description: As a security officer, I want API keys to support optional expiration dates (30d, 90d, 1yr) and display warning badges when expiration is within 7 days.
acceptanceCriteria: Update API key generation modal to include expiration duration picker
Enforce expiration check in /api/v1/ingest (reject expired keys with 401 Expired)
Display amber warning badge on keys list for tokens expiring within 7 days
userStories.notes: Verify time comparisons take UTC into account.

userStories.title: Workspace Invitation Acceptance Flow
userStories.description: As an invited team member, I want to accept an email invitation via a unique token link so that I can set my password and join the workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify invitation token against database and activate membership
Redirect authenticated member directly to the workspace dashboard upon completion
userStories.notes: Clean up pending invitation record once membership is confirmed.
